messages.subject: Error in object@mk_cppmodule(object)

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Error in object@mk_cppmodule(object)
parts:
I've seen things like this before that basically boil down to the fact that the rstan being loaded is not 2.9.0 even though it claims to be. One way that this can happen is if there is a .RData file sitting in the working directory, which gets autoloaded when R is started, that contains a stanfit object created by an old version of rstan. Another way is that the installation of 2.9.0 did not remove / overwrite the libs/ directory of a previous rstan installation for some reason. In that case, do a remove.packages("rstan"). If that doesn't get rid of everything, then in a shell just do a rm -rf rstan/ from whatever directory you install packages into. Then reinstall rstan.

Ben
